title: When Doctors Treated Disease With Mercury

sections.name: When Doctors Treated Disease With Mercury
lines: For about four hundred years, one of the most popular medicines in Europe was liquid metal.
Doctors used mercury to treat syphilis. Patients rubbed it on, swallowed it, or sat in boxes breathing in its fumes.
The side effects were brutal. Drooling, loose teeth, shaking hands, and damaged kidneys.
People even had a saying for it. A night with Venus, a lifetime with mercury.
It finally stopped in the 1940s, when penicillin arrived and cured syphilis properly.
Today, mercury is so toxic that even a broken thermometer gets special cleanup.
